title: P1 research first-attempt run record
description: One JSONL observation produced for the evaluator, never an agent input. This schema specifies well-formed records. Preserve malformed original rows and pass the full JSONL to analyze.py for audit; never filter schema failures out of the scheduled denominator. Decision quality and cost are independent fields.

decision_success.description: Evaluator-scored task endpoint. A completed run requires a boolean. A recognized noncompleted method run is an ITT failure; missing/invalid metadata is not evidence of a measured method failure.

standardized_cost.description: Full-pipeline reference cost for this scheduled first attempt under the frozen cost model. Null means unmeasured/incomplete. An invalid cost must never overwrite an otherwise valid decision_success.

seed.description: Telemetry only. It does not enlarge N or change the four-field run key.

tokens.description: Optional named token counters; document overlapping totals and cache subsets in the usage ledger. The analysis entry point does not recompute cost from this object.
